generations.prompt: Inside a candlelit stone crypt, an older monk in a white habit with a black scapular crouches behind cobwebbed barrels and chests, a plain wall of rough limestone in shadow behind him, warm candlelight on his face from the front. He rises from behind the barrels and half turns away to leave, eyes down, troubled; then a cold blue light floods in from the front right, off frame, growing brighter on his face and on the wall behind him; he stops, turns back toward it, and stares with his mouth open and his eyes wide in awe, the blue light shimmering on his face. Camera static. Photoreal, cinematic film look, 35mm, shallow depth of field, film grain. No text, no captions.
